ITEMDEF_7002906b-d33f-41ee-abd9-a6b616aa.name: Worn synthetic undershirt
ITEMDEF_7002906b-d33f-41ee-abd9-a6b616aa.description: A greyish, oversized shirt made of cheap, non-breathable polymer. It has several dark stains and a frayed collar, typical for someone living in the lower sectors of Orionis.

ITEMDEF_222d38d4-ad0b-49ea-888f-8cf4e194.name: Heavy-duty utility trousers
ITEMDEF_222d38d4-ad0b-49ea-888f-8cf4e194.description: Dark charcoal trousers made from reinforced industrial fabric. They feature multiple reinforced pockets for tools and crystals, though several seams are starting to rip from frequent use.

ITEMDEF_c6dfba7a-ab8e-4225-89b3-79b9eef2.name: Magnetic-sole boots
ITEMDEF_c6dfba7a-ab8e-4225-89b3-79b9eef2.description: Clunky, scuffed boots designed for stability on the metallic gratings of the hive-city. The rubber is worn thin, and the magnetic clamps click faintly with every step.

O002.name: Iron-Veined Slab
O002.description: A jagged protrusion of rock where raw iron ore is visible to the naked eye, partially weathered by wind.

f4c22302-1499-4240-99f6-118e6e21fc4e.name: Cheap hotel room in Orionis
f4c22302-1499-4240-99f6-118e6e21fc4e.description: A cramped, windowless unit with flickering neon lighting and a persistent smell of recycled ozone.
